vibe_rationale: Genuine Indonesian music curation with a values strand, but a large multi-stage expo-site format with many sponsors leans mass-market.
fit_notes: Broad music audience across generations with a sustainability hook (ticket-funded mangrove planting) that a health brand could extend, for example a refill hydration program. Named national partners show large sponsor tiers exist, but no partnership route is published. Jakarta-based, so an Australian brand would need a local partner.
